title: Atomberg & Voltas Execute JV Agreement To Build AC Compressors

llm_summary: Atomberg, a consumer‑appliances startup gearing up for an IPO, has signed a joint‑venture deal with Tata‑owned Voltas to produce air‑conditioner compressors in India.
